notes: Researched 2026-11-11 with WebFetch only. Official sources: the State Service of Ukraine on Food Safety (dpss.gov.ua) lists state hospitals without phones/hours; the Ivano-Frankivsk regional state hospital contact list (vetif.gov.ua) has no hours/species and was not used for entries. No national or regional duty rota (чергові ветлікарні) and no animal poison information line were found; the State Service 24-hour hotline (050 230 04 28, 044 244 82 02) is a general consumer/food-safety call centre, not an animal poison line. Conflict rule: where a clinic page says 'цілодобово' but its own posted hours are shorter (Lessy, Vetmedcomplex, Grand Plus, Zoovet Odesa, CentrVet) emergency_24h is false and the claim is in notes; inpatient-only 24/7 (ArtVet, VetExpert, OlVet, Vetrum) is also false. Unreachable after two tries (client_error or robots.txt): aldenvet.ua, petwealth.kiev.ua, zoopatrul-clinic.com.ua, supervet.ua, 103vet.com.ua, zpolis.com.ua (Kyiv); vetmed.com.ua (Lviv); vivavet.odesa.ua, vetklinika-oficerskaya.com.ua, vetserviceodessa.com, exvet.com.ua, vetekspert.odessa.ua, aybolit.od.ua (Odesa); vet-clinica.dp.ua, kotofey.dp.ua (Dnipro); vetlider.057.ua (Kharkiv); vetcenter.zp.ua, kotopes.org.ua (Zaporizhzhia); vethouse.com.ua, vet-expert.vn.ua (Vinnytsia); pankotskyj.com (Chernivtsi); petfriendlyclinic.com, vetmyr.com.ua (Ivano-Frankivsk/Poltava); veteurolab.0352.ua (Ternopil); kyivcity.gov.ua communal-clinic notice; ua-region.com.ua. Not found with a reachable own page: Chernivtsi (no entry), Mykolaiv, Cherkasy, Khmelnytskyi, Zhytomyr, Chernihiv, Kropyvnytskyi, Sumy; Rivne emergency clinic Dobrovet 24 only seen on aggregators. Lviv communal clinic (2016 article) and the Lviv university Animal Clinic (under reconstruction) were not added. War context: regions under occupation or active fighting (Crimea, Donetsk, Luhansk, Kherson, parts of Zaporizhzhia/Kharkiv/Sumy) were not researched; opening hours in Kharkiv, Dnipro, Odesa, Zaporizhzhia, Kyiv may change with air alerts and curfew, so each 24-h entry should be confirmed by phone.
